VBO:0200268.summary: The Cairnoodle is a Cairn Terrier–Poodle cross. Documented examples include Miniature Poodle parentage.
VBO:0200268.shortDescription: A Cairn Terrier–Poodle cross, with documented Miniature Poodle parentage.

sources.title: Erica Turner — Sadie Mae in the Council Chronicle, July 2021
sources.evidence: Fresh actual passage at Clingy Pet Challenge explicitly defines keeper’s Cairnoodle Sadie as Miniature Poodle/Cairn Terrier mix. Used for parentage only, not to convert an employee’s story into government breed research.
